meta.description: Locate -> Understand -> Change -> Verify with bounded repair loop

nodes.sub_goal: Locate the code relevant to: {goal}. Report the files and symbols involved.

nodes.name: understand
nodes.sub_goal: Understand how the located code works, in service of: {goal}.
